context_item.content: Investigate the nearest parser regression first.

representation_options.raw_episode: Observed failure: parser rejects nested expression. Reproduce with the focused parser test, inspect the state transition, then verify the exact failure path.
representation_options.summary_memory: For parser regressions, reproduce the smallest failing expression before changing shared parsing code.
representation_options.skill: 1. Run the focused parser test. 2. Inspect the failing state transition. 3. Patch the narrowest parser branch. 4. Re-run focused and regression tests.
